svg.title: Epic Cogito Cloud to ZAVA Microsoft Fabric: one-page architecture
svg.desc: Editable vector redraw of the companion PNG in a blue-header, pastel-panel infographic style. Epic clinical applications feed Chronicles and IRIS, then Epic-managed ingestion and Cogito Cloud on Microsoft Fabric. The Fabric SQL and TDS endpoint connects through the illustrated ZAVA Azure private access boundary to supported SQL ingestion in ZAVA Fabric. Raw Epic data and other enterprise data feed a curated customer model, semantic models, Power BI, and data science. Epic analytics remain in Epic. Identity, Conditional Access, hybrid connectivity, Private DNS, and Private Link are shown separately. This is a conceptual redraw, not a verified production deployment.
svg.text: Epic Cogito Cloud to ZAVA Microsoft Fabric
One-page architecture | Managed source, private connectivity, governed analytics

g.text: Operational EHR to Epic-managed Cogito, through the ZAVA Azure security boundary, into customer-owned Fabric analytics.
